evidence_scope: DEV ONLY: 14 previously inspected strict 3+0 players; no reserved-player scores, confirmation, or model promotion
color_rule: rollout 0..24 alternate color; first color from SHA256(seed:player:color) low bit, giving 13/12 per player and the same color in every arm
context_rule: player and opponent ratings are separate history-position medians rounded to nearest integer; speed blitz and time control 180+0; fixed for all games and arms for that player
opponent: same frozen population policy for every arm, with swapped rating context
wrong_identity: next alphabetically sorted development identity, cyclic
shared_identity: arithmetic equal-player mean of the 14 fitted v1 coefficient vectors
coupling: SHA256(seed:player:rollout:ply:role) uniform shared by all arms; sample from UCI-sorted legal moves
termination: stop on python-chess game over with claim_draw=true, otherwise truncate at 160 plies; no resignation, flag fall, or adjudication
human_reference: all 400 assigned history games and 50 validation games per development player; exclude juliowi2 validation game gMUToUOs and report 49; no reserved games or labels
history_blocks: SHA256(seed:player:game_id) ordered history games split into 16 disjoint blocks of 25; validation similarly splits into 25/25 or 25/24
style_measurement: target-move rates and categories; sequence rates from consecutive target moves; pawn structure immediately after last target move per game; opening choice is first target UCI by color; no result, terminal flag, or raw game length enters vector
scale: per-feature standard deviation across 224 disjoint history 25-game blocks, with floor 0.05 for rates and 0.5 for pawn counts; calculated only from history
identity_classifier: nearest equal-player history centroid by mean of seven family mean squared standardized distances; deterministic alphabetic tie break; target rank percentile among 14 identities is identity error
behavior_distance: mean of seven family mean absolute standardized errors, each clipped at 4 then divided by 4; generated and human validation aggregate vectors compared on same frozen train scale
primary_composite: 0.5 * target identity rank percentile + 0.5 * behavior distance; lower is better; family weights equal
resolution_gate: report held-out human validation block classifier accuracy/confusion against 1/14 chance; if accuracy is at or below 2/14, no generated identity claim
uncertainty: 2000 seeded bootstrap resamples of 14 paired players; matched rollouts and uniform draws are reused across arms; report mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles for personal minus each control
candidate_bundle: baseline run uses only four arms; any objective-ablation policy bundle requires a separately declared second run with its own output and hashes
